preamble: Between vowels, the voiced retroflex stop [ɖ] lenited to a retroflex lateral [ɭ]. The tongue keeps its curled-back position, but the full closure is replaced by lateral airflow.

examples.note: Rigveda 1.1.1 'agním īḷe' ('I praise Agni') is written with ḷ in the samhita text, while some traditions and concordances give īḍe; whether Vedic ḷ was a lateral or a flap is debated.
'to play': Pali kīḷati corresponds to Sanskrit krīḍati (Pali Text Society dictionary).
